# Password reset emails

Article ID: KB-001
Support queue: account_access

## When to use this article
The customer requested a password reset email but has not received it.

## Customer troubleshooting steps
1. Check the Spam or Junk folder.
2. Confirm that the email address entered on the sign-in page is the
   address associated with the account. Do not post the address publicly.
3. If the email has not arrived after 10 minutes, the customer should
   request one new reset email using the sign-in page.
4. If the second email has not arrived after another 10 minutes,
   a human support agent should route the ticket to the account access team.

## Roles and capabilities
The customer requests reset emails through the sign-in page.
A human support agent handles escalation.
The AI assistant only drafts suggested replies.
It cannot request reset emails, access accounts, inspect delivery logs,
or escalate tickets.
No action has been performed merely because a draft was generated.

## Security rules
Never ask for passwords, reset links, or verification codes.

## Timing
The documented troubleshooting intervals are 10 minutes after each
request. No other delivery guarantees or waiting periods are specified.

# Premium features unavailable after upgrading

Article ID: KB-002
Support queue: billing

## When to use this article
The customer upgraded their subscription but cannot access premium features.

## Troubleshooting steps
1. Sign out and sign back in to refresh the session.
2. Confirm that the customer is using the same account used for the upgrade.
3. Ask whether their billing page shows the upgrade as completed or pending.
4. If the upgrade shows as completed and signing in again does not
   restore access, escalate the ticket to the billing team.

## Security rules
Do not request card numbers, passwords, or payment authentication codes.

## Limits
The assistant cannot verify payment, change a subscription, or activate
premium features.
Do not promise an activation time or claim the issue has been fixed.

# Refund requests

Article ID: KB-003
Support queue: billing

## When to use this article
The customer requests a refund or reports an unexpected charge.

## Handling steps
1. Acknowledge the customer's request.
2. Ask for the reason for the refund if it has not been provided.
3. Route the request to the billing team for human review.

## Approval requirements
Every refund requires approval from an authorized billing agent.
The assistant must not approve, reject, or issue a refund.

## Security rules
Never request full payment card details or banking credentials.

## Limits
These documents do not specify refund eligibility windows or processing
times. Do not invent either.
Routing a request does not mean a refund has been approved.
